name: Feast
description: Enters a feeding frenzy for %duration% turns, making %attacks% free attack on an adjacent enemy each turn.
details: Each free attack heals this unit for %lifesteal:pct%% of the damage dealt and roots the victim for %root_duration% turn.
This unit is free to move and act as normal throughout.

upgrade.summary: The hunger never lifts - every attack heals and roots, frenzy or not.
upgrade.description: The frenzy is permanent: every attack this unit makes heals it for %lifesteal:pct%% of the damage dealt and roots the victim for %root_duration% turn. Casting this takes %attacks% free attack on an adjacent enemy.
details: There is no duration to run out and nothing to keep up - the lifesteal and the root are simply always on.
The cast is now only the free attack, which is why it is still worth the cooldown.
